about: RNZ (Radio New Zealand): search and read NZ news, tag, section and author listings, Life articles, podcasts and episodes, radio schedules, RSS feeds and video metadata.

commands.summary: Keyword search across RNZ news stories and audio items, with paging.
List stories tagged with a topic slug, e.g. housing.
List the latest news stories in a news section, e.g. education, political, world, business or sport.
List articles written by an RNZ reporter, identified by author slug.
Get the latest stories in a news category from its RSS feed (structured title, link, date, description).

params.name: category
params.description: RSS feed name as listed by list-rss-feeds, e.g. national, political, world, business, sport, pacific

commands.summary: List all available RNZ RSS feeds and their URLs.
Get a news article's headline, description, publish time and body text.

params.name: section
params.description: Section slug from the article URL

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric story id from the article URL

params.name: slug
params.description: Headline slug from the article URL

commands.summary: Get metadata (headline, description, dates, image) for a radio programme audio item.

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric audio id from the URL

commands.summary: List RNZ Life (arts, culture, music, lifestyle) articles in a category such as music.
Get an RNZ Life article's headline, description and body text.
List all RNZ podcasts (A–Z) with their slugs.
Get a podcast's recent episodes from its RSS feed, including title, date, duration and MP3 URL.
List a podcast's episodes published in a given year (an archive beyond the RSS feed's latest items).
Get the RNZ National radio schedule (programmes) for a date; returns today's schedule when no date is given.
List RNZ video series and documentaries, with their slugs.
